summary: End-to-end test of Roobani: 17/17 backend tests pass and all critical frontend flows verified (home, plans, signup→dashboard, login→dashboard, contact, /about route, dashboard auth redirect, lead form submission with PII encryption, sharp corners, no em dashes, navbar glass on scroll). One blocking issue: the documented test credentials use the reserved TLD '.test' which Pydantic's EmailStr rejects (422), so investor@roobani.test cannot register or log in as-is. After substituting investor@roobani.dev all flows work perfectly.

critical.issue: Documented test credentials investor@roobani.test FAIL validation. Pydantic email-validator rejects reserved-use TLD .test with HTTP 422 ('special-use or reserved name'). Either update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to use @roobani.dev (or similar), OR configure EmailStr with allow_special_use=True. Currently no email on a reserved TLD (.test, .invalid, .localhost) can be used anywhere in the app.

ui_bugs.issue: Show-password eye toggle is rendered but lacks data-testid='login-show-password' (count=0). Other login testids OK.

issues: All sampled buttons/cards have border-radius 0px (sharp corners) - PASS
No em dash (U+2014) present on Home - PASS
Navbar HEADER picks up rb-glass class after scroll > 16px - PASS

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to use a non-reserved TLD (e.g. investor@roobani.dev) OR allow special-use TLDs in EmailStr so the documented credentials work. This blocks any QA/Emergent agent that tries to register/login with the documented account.
Add data-testid='login-show-password' to the password show/hide toggle on Login page (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: PII encryption verified: leads collection persists only email_enc / phone_enc Fernet ciphertext (gAAAAA...), no plaintext email/phone field. Users collection stores email_enc (encrypted) plus email_lookup (lowercase plaintext) - email_lookup is necessary for unique index/login lookup, which is acceptable.

Pydantic v2 EmailStr by default uses email-validator which rejects .test/.invalid/.localhost TLDs as 'special-use reserved'. This silently breaks the documented test credentials. Add `from pydantic import EmailStr` with a custom validator, or use `email_validator.validate_email(..., allow_special=True)`, or update the credentials to use a valid TLD.

Account lockout works correctly: after 5 failed attempts, the next attempt (even with correct password) returns 423 with 15-minute lock and resets failed_attempts. Confirmed via test_lockout_after_five_failures.
/api/auth/session correctly returns 401 for invalid Emergent session_id.
Bearer-token authentication works (cookie session_token can also be sent as Authorization: Bearer).
Market endpoints: /api/market/crypto returns BTC + ETH with sparkline. /api/market/stocks returns indices/commodities/forex with full schema. 45s cache observed.
test_credentials: Use investor@roobani.dev / Roobani#2026 (NOT .test). The .test TLD in the saved credentials file is rejected by EmailStr.
seed_data_creation: Created investor@roobani.dev / Roobani#2026 via /api/auth/register during testing. Multiple TEST_-prefixed leads, contacts, and throwaway users were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. They use @roobani.dev addresses to dodge the .test TLD validation. Frontend lead form submission works end-to-end; the country code select uses values like '+91' (select_option index=0 picked +1). Dashboard redirects to /login when session cookie is missing. Signup auto-logs in and routes to /dashboard. Login error message uses the literal string 'Invalid email or password'.
rca of the issue: RCA - Test credential mismatch: Pydantic v2 + email-validator strictly rejects TLDs in the IANA reserved list (.test, .invalid, .example, .localhost). /app/memory/test_credentials.md documents investor@roobani.test which causes /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/leads, /api/contact, and any EmailStr-validated endpoint to return 422. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with email=investor@roobani.test → 422 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name'. Mitigation: (a) change documented credentials to @roobani.dev, OR (b) replace EmailStr with a custom validator that calls email_validator.validate_email(email, allow_special=True), OR (c) configure email_validator globally.
